nodes.label: API.md — Web-facing API Surface
nodes.rationale: The web app is a direct Supabase client (like mobile) with no BFF layer in v1; the doc covers browser-called edge functions, external HTTP APIs, and a deliberately minimal Next.js server surface.

nodes.label: send-security-otp Edge Function
nodes.rationale: POST {purpose: account_deletion|email_change}; recipient always resolved server-side from the JWT — the client never supplies an email; 60 s per-user-per-purpose cooldown (429 cooldown_active).

nodes.label: delete-account Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Requires a Bearer token whose amr contains a fresh (<=10 min) otp/magiclink entry; runs a fail-closed wipe state machine (deletion_pending flag, storage purge, delete_user_data RPC, admin.deleteUser last) — never reimplemented client-side.

nodes.label: bullion-history Edge Function
nodes.rationale: GET ?days=30..400 returning Yahoo futures rows with CORS *; exists because browsers/native cannot hit Yahoo directly — web must use it instead of calling Yahoo itself.

nodes.label: fetch-nepal-gold-rate Edge Function
nodes.rationale: Service-role / pg_cron only — the web must never call it.

nodes.label: External Public HTTP APIs (FX, Gold, Push)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated public endpoints (open.er-api.com, api.frankfurter.app, api.gold-api.com, exp.host); nothing sensitive is sent; a CORS or rate-limit problem is solved by a new/extended edge function, never a Next.js proxy holding keys.

nodes.label: /auth/callback OAuth PKCE Route Handler
nodes.rationale: Exchanges the Google PKCE code, sets session cookies, rejects untrusted redirects (startsWith('/') && !startsWith('//')); derives origin from forwarded Host only in dev (audit P3-1); routes type=recovery sessions to /profile?recovery=1; next dev normalizes request.url so the route must build targets from the Host header (docs/SUPABASE.md §7).
